text: I think you'll love this recipe, Ridiculously Easy Mexican Beans, because it's not only quick and easy to make, but it's also packed with protein, which aligns perfectly with your health goal. With 22 grams of protein per serving, this dish will help you meet your protein needs in no time. Plus, it's vegan, so you can enjoy it guilt-free. The combination of black beans and Mexican flavoured tomatoes creates a flavorful and satisfying meal that can be paired with cornbread or steamed vegetables, all within your 15-minute time budget.
